九尾がひらく夜、願いの底へ。: Beneath nine unfurled tails, descend into the heart of a wish.
今宵も、あの姫に逢うために。: Tonight, we return to see her once more.
覚醒核はこの難易度だけ。道中の消耗を抑え、薬と役割を整えて九尾に挑む。: Awakening Cores drop only here. Conserve your strength on the way, prepare potions and roles, and face the Nine-Tailed Princess.
葛葉の契りを集め、妖狐の姫を仲間に迎える。: Gather Kuzuha's covenant fragments and welcome the fox princess into your party.
月翅の群れを抜け、星の欠片を拾う。: Pass through moonlit wings and gather fallen stars.
月の光が降り積もる庭。月翅の蛾と白霧の狼を越え、最後に月翅の主へ挑む。全体攻撃を: A garden dusted with moonlight. Defeat Moon Moths and Pale Wolves before facing the lord of the wings. A short, two-wave route suited to area attacks. Earn one Wishstone every clear.
癒しの祈りが響く回廊を、ひと息に。: Press through the cloister before its healing prayers return.
白い花が導く祈りの道。帳の巫女が狼を癒し、奥では巫女自身が道を守る。攻撃重視で回: White flowers mark a path of prayer. A Veiled Priestess heals the wolves, then guards the way herself. Overcome her healing in this short, two-wave route. Earn one Wishstone every clear.
石燐の鱗と銀の鎧、その先の灯へ。: Beyond stoneglow scales and silver armor, a lantern waits.
銀灯が揺れる古い門。石燐の幼竜と荊の魔女を越え、虚ろの守り手と向き合う。回復を織: An ancient gate lit by silver lanterns. Defeat a Stone Drake and Thorn Witch, then face the Hollow Guardian. Balance healing with sustained offense over two waves. Earn one Wishstone every clear.
神々も、今宵は黒いレースを纏う。: Tonight, even the gods wear black lace.
よくいらしたわ。今宵は、どんな願いを預けるの？: Welcome. What wish will you entrust to me tonight?
ふふ……その眼差し、少し気に入ったわ。: Hehe… I am beginning to like that look in your eyes.
また逢いにきて。契りの続きは、その時に。: Come see me again. We shall continue our covenant then.
九つの尾がほどける夜。もう、夢からは帰さない。: On the night my nine tails unfurl, even dreams will not lead you home.
ここまで追ってくるなんて……本気にしてしまうわ。: You followed me this far… You might make me take this seriously.
あなたの願い、九つの尾に結びましょう。: Let us bind your wish to these nine tails.
……ここから先は、夢さえ帰れない。: …Beyond this point, even dreams cannot return.
まだ、その灯を消すわけにはいかない。: I cannot let that light go out. Not yet.
ようやく……あの人の足音が、聞こえる。: At last… I can hear those footsteps again.
この庭の眠りを、誰が呼び覚ました。: Who has disturbed this garden's sleep?
石は砕けても……約束は、残る。: Stone may shatter… but a promise remains.
花を……踏まないで、おくれ。: Please… do not tread on the flowers.
名を捨てた者だけが、この門を守れる。: Only those who abandon their names may guard this gate.
主よ……もう少しだけ、お待ちください。: My liege… please wait just a little longer.
鍵を、あなたに。今度こそ……扉の向こうへ。: The key is yours. This time… beyond the door.
欠けた月の夢を、あなたにも。: May you, too, dream beneath the waning moon.
夜明けなど……来なくても、よかったのに。: Perhaps… dawn need never have come.
この祈りだけは、奪わないで。: Please, do not take this prayer from me.
届かないと知っても……私は、祈る。: Even knowing it cannot reach them… I will pray.
こんなにも静かに……終われるのですね。: So this is how quietly… it can end.
枯れた花にも、帰る場所はある。: Even withered flowers have a place to return to.
咲かせましょう……最後の、一輪を。: Let it bloom… one final flower.
庭のこと……ときどき、思い出して。: Remember the garden… once in a while.
誰もいない礼拝堂に、今日も花を供える祈り手。救えなかった人々の名を、彼女だけがま: She still lays flowers in an empty chapel. Only she remembers the names of those she could not save. Beneath her gentle voice lies a quiet resolve never to let go of another hand.
滅びた王国の門を守り続けた騎士。主のいない盾は重さを失わず、彼女はその重さを生き: A knight who still guards the gate of a fallen kingdom. Her masterless shield has never grown lighter; she has made its weight a reason to live. A woman of few words, she never forgets to match her companions' pace.
朝の来ない街で剣を振るう旅人。彼女の刃は、過ぎ去ったものへの弔いであり、まだ見ぬ: A traveler who carries her sword through a city without morning. Her blade mourns what has passed and points toward a tomorrow still unseen. She gazes at rain-washed cobblestones as though remembering another life.
消えた星座を読み続ける魔術師。崩れた天文台から持ち出した一冊の本には、誰にも見え: A mage who still reads constellations that have vanished. The book she rescued from a ruined observatory records a sky no one else can see. At night, she teaches her companions the forgotten names of stars.
聖堂に迷い込んだ魂を、出口まで導く白い獣。その足跡は霧とともに消える。かつて誰か: A white beast that guides lost souls out of the cathedral. Its footprints dissolve into mist. It once waited for someone, they say, but can no longer remember their face.
崩れた噴水の底で長い眠りについていた竜。石のような鱗の隙間から、青白い光がこぼれ: A drake long asleep beneath a broken fountain. Pale blue light seeps between its stone-like scales. It walks with surprising care, unwilling to crush even the smallest flower.
錆銀の鎧に名前を隠した女騎士。朽ちた鍵束を腰に下げ、閉じるべき扉を探している。鎧: A woman knight whose name is hidden behind tarnished armor. With old keys at her waist, she searches for doors that should be closed. Inside the armor, a tiny, faded ribbon is still carefully sewn in place.
月明かりの差す場所にだけ現れる幻の蛾。翅に散る燐粉は、触れた者に遠い夢を見せる。: An elusive moth that appears only in moonlight. Dust from its wings brings dreams of distant places. Some say it carries the words of the dead; others believe it is the loneliness of the living given form.
破れた聖歌を口ずさむ、角を持つ女性。人々が去った後も祈りの灯を絶やさなかった。差: A horned woman who hums a broken hymn. Long after the people left, she kept the light of prayer alive. When she takes an offered hand, her cold fingers tremble ever so slightly.
花を咲かせなくなった庭に暮らす魔女。荊の冠は罰ではなく、彼女自身が選んだ約束のし: A witch who lives in a garden where flowers no longer bloom. Her crown of thorns is a promise she chose, not a punishment. Whenever someone brings her seeds, the corners of her mouth soften into a smile.
神楽の舞台で、赤茶の短い髪と紅いリボンを弾ませる女神。神楽鈴を高く掲げ、扇を開き: A goddess whose short auburn hair and red ribbon sway across the kagura stage. She raises her sacred bells and opens her fan, dancing in black and ivory gothic lace. She believes laughter can return even to a city sealed in silence.
富士を背に、桜の枝と小さな炎をそっと掲げる女神。桜色と黒いレースのゴシックロリー: With Mount Fuji behind her, she holds a cherry branch and a small flame. Dressed in pink and black gothic lace, she plays with sparks as though they were petals. Her prayers, knowing both fragility and strength, quietly keep her companions alive.
岩戸の向こうから朝を連れてくる女神。黒髪のボブに太陽の光輪を戴き、白と黒のフリル: A goddess who brings morning from beyond the heavenly cave. A solar halo crowns her dark bob, and gold adorns her black-and-white gothic frills. When the Yata Mirror catches dawn, warmth returns even to the shuttered city.
黄泉の境界に立つ女神が、銀髪を黒い喪のヴェールで包み、黒と紫のゴシックロリータを: At the boundary of Yomi, a goddess veils her silver hair in black mourning lace. She wears gothic frills of black and violet, a magatama at her breast, and carries red spider lilies and an old lantern. Before a sealed rock, she now chooses to protect the companions beside her.
宵宮の妖狐姫: Fox Princess of the Dusk Shrine
参拝者の途絶えた稲荷の社で、今も人々の願いを預かる妖狐の姫。紅の結び紐と古い鈴は: At an abandoned Inari shrine, a fox princess still accepts people's wishes. Every red cord and old bell marks another forgotten covenant. The smile behind her fan hides both the pleasure of testing visitors and the loneliness of waiting for someone.
月が欠ける夜、封じた九つの尾と白銀の髪が本来の姿を取り戻す。揺れる狐火は、守りき: Under an eclipsed moon, her silver hair and nine sealed tails regain their true form. Each wandering foxfire remembers a wish she could not protect. Yet she quietly writes your name—the one who chose to stand beside her—upon her final binding cord.
羽音だけが静寂を渡る。: Only the sound of wings crosses the silence.
眠れる水底に、青い灯。: A blue light sleeps beneath the water.
届かぬ聖歌の、その先へ。: Beyond a hymn that never reaches its listeners.
枯れた花々の名前を呼ぶ。: Call the names of flowers long withered.
最後の鍵は、まだ冷たい。: The last key is still cold.
頁に残された月の匂い。: The scent of moonlight lingers on its pages.
もう見えない星を探して。: Search for stars no longer visible.
ここで、ひとつの祈りが終わる。: Here, a single prayer comes to an end.
